title: A transfer principle for Steklov eigenvalue estimates of graphs
summary: In this paper, we establish a new variant of the Burger-Brooks transfer principle, which allows us to apply spectral estimates for measured Riemannian surfaces to obtain the following result: There exists a universal constant $C>0$ such that, for every connected graph $G=(V, E)$ with boundary $B$, maximum degree $d_{\max}$ and genus $g$, \[σ_k(G, B)\leq C d_{\max}\frac{g+k}{|B|},\] where $1\leq k\leq |B|$ and $σ_k(G, B)$ denotes the $k$-th Steklov eigenvalue of $G$ with boundary $B$.
